routeOrSurface: Command palette → original Create Project dialog
customerOutcome: Review an editable project name and goal, then explicitly save a planned project through the original owner.
entryConditions: Current resolved principal and selected company match the original command scope.
A current original command response offers create_project; text alone causes no writes.
Unresolved current-session checks conceal the private draft.
exitConditions: Cancellation leaves no project until an explicit submission.
Only the original creator-bound Native idempotency receipt and a current actor/company-bound project read permit saved-project presentation.

content.supportingCopy: Review and edit your project before saving it.
displayedState: Pending or unconfirmed creation; reconcile the original nonce with reads
Current authorized project receipt or unavailable state

inputs.label: Project name
inputs.default: Verbatim text after the explicit English/Danish create-project command
inputs.validation: Trimmed non-empty value; input limited to 180 characters
inputs.autofillOrPrefill: Original same-account command text; no inferred agents, dates or access

inputs.label: Goal or description (optional)
inputs.help: Agent assignments, dates and access are separate decisions.

primary.label: Create project
primary.operation: Submit only the original frozen name/description/planned-status/idempotency key to the Native project owner

secondary: Check project receipt reads the original nonce without another create
Open project only after a current original-owner read

canonicalReadDomains: Original Native creator-bound Project create-receipt lookup with current project read authorization
systemWork.canonicalWriteOperation: Original POST /api/companies/:companyId/projects with its existing actor-scoped Native idempotency receipt; no second writer or store
systemWork.authorityEffect: A draft and a command do not grant permissions. The original Native owner admits explicit project creation. No repository, runtime, lead-agent assignment or job is requested.
systemWork.asyncWork: One explicit original-owner POST. Unconfirmed outcomes reconcile only through GET of the original Native nonce; reload never reconstructs or resends the creation body.
systemWork.receipt: Minimal current project ID/company/name after a fresh creator-bound Native receipt read. Bounded per-tab sessionStorage keeps only version/company/principal/nonce, never project content, and removes the locator after a confirmed current read.

states.loading: Conceal prior private fields and receipts during current session or original-source checks.
states.empty: Explain an actual empty authorized result. Missing dependencies or qualified capabilities are separate unavailable states.
states.partial: Retain trustworthy available results and name unavailable dependencies or sources.
states.stale: Remove executable actions and refresh canonical state; preserved input is not evidence of current authority.
states.validation_error: Preserve other entered values, identify the field problem and associate it programmatically with the control.
states.system_error: Explain that the operation is unconfirmed, preserve entered data, and offer a valid retry/refresh or support route.
states.permission_denied: Withhold the private draft/receipt when the account changes or original project read is denied.
states.recovering: Recheck original current authority and read the retained original nonce. Missing or erased Native evidence remains unconfirmed and cannot authorize another create.
states.success: Present only the current authorized original project. Open it to add tasks and review any configured automation; this receipt does not attest to all downstream execution.

navigation.back: The same mounted account/company draft retains entered name/goal during session rechecks.
navigation.cancelOrSaveExit: Cancel closes the draft. Only the content-free original nonce/scope survives an unknown submitted outcome in this tab; an already committed project remains in Projects.
navigation.resume: After reload, opening a project draft resumes the original creator-bound receipt through GET. Failed or corrupt recovery storage blocks creation and offers Projects.

accessibility.initialFocus: Main heading or the dialog category control; keyboard focus is visible and unobscured.
accessibility.focusAfterError: Error summary or first invalid control, with a programmatically associated explanation.
accessibility.focusAfterSuccess: Canonical receipt or next-step heading; announcements do not trap focus.
accessibility.keyboardModel: Standard buttons, links, labeled text inputs and semantic single-select controls; dialog Escape/close and focus return use the native primitive.
accessibility.statusAnnouncement: Use status for pending/success and alert for material failures, without repeated routine interruption.
accessibility.targetSize: Custom frequent and primary controls target at least 44 × 44 CSS px.
accessibility.zoomReflow: Require browser/manual verification at 200% and 400% zoom and narrow mobile width; this file is not proof of conformance.
accessibility.reducedMotion: No essential animated transition or moving progress indicator.
accessibility.screenReaderNotes: One meaningful H1, persistent visible labels, named sections and logical DOM/focus order.

responsive.wide: Readable constrained content width with natural wrapping.
responsive.narrow: Reflow cards and form actions without concealing utilities or consequences.
responsive.mobile: Touch targets remain reachable; dialogs scroll within the viewport and do not obscure focus.

dataShown: Only the current account/company-scoped draft and original project name/reference
dataCollected: Only explicit name/description, planned status and original idempotency key
sensitiveFields: Raw intent, company facts, feedback and results remain customer data
privacySecurity.loggingConstraints: Generic HTTP logs for the original project namespace omit query, body, private errors and entity IDs. The original Native project audit remains purpose-separated.

functional: Verify a single original Native create, lost acknowledgement and first receipt-read failure, reload recovery through GET, current Native name, cleared content-free locator and zero created agents/tasks/runs on the exact artifact.
accessibility: Verify keyboard/focus/announcements and 200/400% zoom manually on the exact artifact.
securityPrivacy: Verify current membership/resource revocation, tenant isolation, untrusted content and separate private feedback identity purpose.
usability: Use representative exploratory and pre-registered confirmatory journey evidence with explicit PASS/FAIL/INCONCLUSIVE; source checks are insufficient.
